local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local head = character:WaitForChild("Head")

local flashlight = Instance.new("SpotLight")
flashlight.Range = 60
flashlight.Brightness = 2
flashlight.Angle = 90

        flashlight.Enabled = not flashlight.Enabled

scripts.script:
local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet(('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shlexware/Orion/main/source')))()
local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({Name = "Pedulm Hub | Dandy's World", HidePremium = false, SaveConfig = true, ConfigFolder = "PedulmHub"})

local MainTab = Window:MakeTab({Name = "Main", Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998", PremiumOnly = false})

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

MainTab:AddSlider({
    Name = "Walk Speed",
    Min = 16,
    Max = 100,
    Default = 16,
    Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),
    Increment = 1,
    ValueName = "Speed",
    Callback = function(value)
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = value
    end
})

MainTab:AddButton({
    Name = "Enable ESP",
    Callback = function()
        for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Model") and v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                local esp = Instance.new("Highlight")
                esp.Adornee = v
                esp.Parent = v
            end
        end
    end
})

MainTab:AddButton({
    Name = "Auto Farm",
    Callback = function()
        while wait(1) do
            for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace.Resources:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("Model") and v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = v.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
                    wait(0.5)
                end
            end
        end
    end
})

local TeleportTab = Window:MakeTab({Name = "Teleport", Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998", PremiumOnly = false})

local generators = {
    ["Gerador 1"] = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0),
    ["Gerador 2"] = CFrame.new(10, 0, 0),
    ["Gerador 3"] = CFrame.new(20, 0, 0),
    ["Gerador 4"] = CFrame.new(30, 0, 0),
    ["Gerador 5"] = CFrame.new(40, 0, 0),
    ["Gerador 6"] = CFrame.new(50, 0, 0)
}

for name, cframe in pairs(generators) do
    TeleportTab:AddButton({
        Name = name,
        Callback = function()
            player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = cframe
        end
    })
end

    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 69, 0)) -- Red
})
